text: {"features":[{"evidence":"repeated visible typos","name":"Proofreading accuracy","description":"Captures how free the letter is from spelling and typographical errors that distract from the application.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Frequent spelling or typing errors throughout; looks unproofread and distracts from the substance."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Several noticeable errors; still readable, but the presentation feels sloppy."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Minor isolated errors only; mostly clean and professional."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Essentially error-free and polished."}]},{"evidence":"scaling scarce security judgment through automation","name":"Role mandate understanding","description":"Captures how specifically the letter shows the applicant understands this job as building automation for security response, triage, risk reduction, and AI-assisted workflows rather than just generic software engineering.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Expresses generic interest in the job with little sign of understanding the team's actual security-automation work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions security, tooling, or Google scale, but only at a broad level."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Clearly connects past work to concrete parts of the mandate such as vulnerability handling, lifecycle security, or AI-assisted tooling."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows nuanced understanding of the team's leverage model and names specific problem types such as triage automation, scaling expert judgment, variant analysis, or secure-default tooling."}]},{"evidence":"improvements inherited by every team downstream","name":"Platform leverage orientation","description":"Captures how strongly the applicant is motivated by shared infrastructure work whose effects compound across many teams or products.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No real signal of interest in shared infrastructure or broad downstream impact."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"General statements about scale or impact without tying them to platform work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Explicitly says they prefer foundational or internal tooling work with organization-wide reach."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Frames past choices and future goals around compounding leverage from shared systems across many teams."}]},{"evidence":"make the secure path the easy path for busy engineers","name":"Developer enablement mindset","description":"Captures whether the letter frames security tooling as something that helps developer teams adopt safer defaults with less friction.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not discuss the needs or behavior of developer users."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions helping teams in generic terms."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Explicitly focuses on reducing friction or making the secure path easier for developers."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows clear empathy for busy engineers and explains adoption in terms of defaults, workflows, and usable tooling rather than process."}]},{"evidence":"learned how systems actually fail by testing and maintaining them","name":"Failure-oriented maintainer mindset","description":"Captures whether the letter presents maintenance, reliability, inheritance, and failure analysis as a core way the applicant thinks about engineering.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No maintenance or failure perspective beyond a standard experience summary."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Notes testing or maintenance experience but does not develop it into a mindset."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes learning from maintenance, testing, or inherited systems and applies that lens to new work."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Makes failure analysis, maintainability, or the fact that others inherit systems the central organizing principle of the letter."}]},{"evidence":"3, 5, or 7 years of software development","name":"Professional tenure","description":"Captures the amount of full-time software engineering experience the applicant presents.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Roughly minimum-posting experience, about 2 to 3 years."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Solid mid-level experience, about 4 to 5 years."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Extended experience, about 6 to 7 years or more."}]},{"evidence":"launched 2, 4, or 6 production services","name":"Production service track record","description":"Captures the breadth of hands-on production ownership implied by the number of services the applicant has tested, maintained, or launched.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Limited production breadth, around 2 launched or owned services."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Moderate breadth, around 4 services."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Broad track record, around 6 or more services."}]},{"evidence":"Bachelor's, Master's, or Doctoral degree in computer science","name":"Academic degree level","description":"Captures the highest formal computer science degree the letter claims.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Bachelor's degree or equivalent only."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Master's degree."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Doctoral degree."}]},{"evidence":"turned vulnerability reports into a classified, routed pipeline","name":"Vulnerability automation ownership","description":"Captures whether the applicant has directly built tooling that automates intake, triage, routing, deduplication, or prioritization of security findings.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No direct vulnerability triage or intake automation experience."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions related automation vaguely but without clear ownership or scope."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Clearly states they built tooling for report intake, triage, routing, or queue reduction."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes concrete triage functions or outcomes such as classification, deduplication, prioritization, routing, self-serve handling, or measurable workload reduction."}]},{"evidence":"Python agents operating under Go guardrails","name":"Agentic architecture experience","description":"Captures direct experience designing systems where agents act autonomously within explicit back-end controls, permissions, or audits.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No direct agentic-system design described."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions agents, automation, or multi-step workflows only in broad terms."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Clear experience pairing agents with back-end services or constraints."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Sophisticated description of agent autonomy plus guardrails such as permissions, auditing, bounded actions, or explicit control planes."}]},{"evidence":"LLM-backed features hardened against failure modes","name":"Applied AI maturity","description":"Captures how much real production experience the applicant claims with AI features, especially reliability, evaluation, or failure-mode handling.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No meaningful AI or LLM experience described."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions AI features or interest without production detail."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States they shipped AI or LLM-backed functionality in production."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows production maturity by discussing evaluation, reliability, unpredictable inputs, failure modes, or trustworthiness."}]},{"evidence":"Python as workhorse for automation and services","name":"Python depth","description":"Captures how central and production-grade Python appears in the applicant's recent work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Python is absent or only implied."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Python is mentioned as a basic scripting or tooling language."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Python appears as a regular language for automation, internal services, or prototyping."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Python is presented as deeply production-grade or central to the applicant's tooling, service, or agent work."}]},{"evidence":"threat models, security reviews, and validating fixes","name":"Security assessment practice","description":"Captures the extent of hands-on experience performing security assessments rather than only expressing interest in security.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No direct security assessment work described."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Vague claim of doing reviews or assessments."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Clear hands-on work such as threat models, service reviews, or design and release assessments."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Mature assessment practice with attacker mindset, validation of fixes, cross-stack perspective, or a strong explanation of how assessments are done."}]},{"evidence":"streaming computation, cache eviction, in-memory index redesign","name":"Algorithms fluency","description":"Captures whether the applicant supports claims about data structures and algorithms with concrete engineering examples.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No meaningful algorithms or data-structures evidence."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Generic self-claim without an example."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"At least one concrete example of using algorithms or data structures to improve a system."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Multiple or especially strong examples showing the applicant thinks algorithmically in system design."}]},{"evidence":"CompTIA Security+ versus OSCP","name":"Formal security credentialing","description":"Captures the strength of third-party security certification signals provided in the letter.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No security certification named."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Baseline certification such as CompTIA Security+."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Strong hands-on certification such as OSCP."}]},{"evidence":"capture-the-flag participation and placements","name":"Offensive practice intensity","description":"Captures how much the applicant demonstrates live security practice through recurring CTF participation or strong results.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No CTF or offensive-practice signal."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Some participation in CTFs or similar recurring practice."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Strong practice signal such as serious competition, regular involvement, or near-top placements."}]},{"evidence":"patches upstream or maintainer of a public framework","name":"Open-source ownership","description":"Captures whether the applicant shows external engineering accountability through contributing to or maintaining open-source software.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No open-source contribution signal."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Contributes patches or occasional fixes upstream."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Maintains an active open-source project or framework with outside users."}]},{"evidence":"distributed task queue, replicated cache, sharded database","name":"Personal project rigor","description":"Captures how technically ambitious and sustained the applicant's side projects appear.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No side project, or only a very small utility with limited technical depth."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"A modest but completed project showing initiative and follow-through."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"A technically ambitious, sustained infrastructure-style project with challenging reliability, consistency, or storage concerns."}]},{"evidence":"measured outcomes and concrete systems instead of broad claims","name":"Evidence specificity","description":"Captures how consistently the letter backs claims with named systems, concrete actions, or explicit outcomes.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mostly generic assertions with little supporting detail."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mixes some specifics with many unsupported claims."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Frequently backs claims with named systems, concrete actions, or plausible outcomes."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Consistently substantiates fit with crisp technical examples and clear consequences."}]},{"evidence":"memorable framing like 'security work is when nothing happens'","name":"Narrative distinctiveness","description":"Captures how memorable and cohesive the letter's voice and overall story are beyond a checklist of qualifications.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Reads as transactional or template-like, with little memorable voice."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Clear and competent but conventional."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Has a noticeable voice or coherent personal arc that helps the reader remember the candidate."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Uses distinctive framing and a well-integrated story that actively strengthens the case for fit."}]}]}
